shots.line: On Sunday, September fourteenth, according to the court,
shots.what: road map near the barracks; chapter lettering CHAPTER 02 / THE SWAMP and the date type on

shots.line: a man walking his dog
shots.what: real: Jim Novak, who found it, walking through the woods with a reporter

shots.line: spotted a Jeep stuck in a retention pond,
shots.what: real photo: Frein's Jeep in the reeds and water

shots.line: sitting partly under water,
shots.what: same photo, closer on the waterline

shots.line: and reported it to state police.
shots.what: real: Novak pointing across the pond site

shots.line: The Jeep was registered to Eric Frein's parents.
shots.what: real: Novak telling it (a part of the interview without the station's own caption); name tag types on

shots.line: Inside, police found
shots.what: the Jeep photo again, tight on the open window

shots.line: a black rifle case,
shots.what: 3D object: a black rifle case under a lamp, push in

shots.line: two spent cartridge casings,
shots.what: 3D object: two spent casings, close

shots.line: and Eric Frein's driver's license.
shots.what: 3D object: a licence-sized card, blank where the photo would be (no face drawn)

shots.line: His own notes would later explain the Jeep.
shots.what: 3D object: torn notebook pages (writing not legible)

shots.line: After the shooting, he'd tried to get away in it
shots.what: real: the rutted track leading down to the pond

shots.line: and ended up in the swamp.
shots.what: real: the pond field at the site

shots.line: He called it a disaster.
shots.what: typed quote card

shots.line: Then he went into the woods on foot.
shots.what: 3D: the amber figure walking away into the trees

shots.line: So within a couple of days, police had
shots.what: real: the State Police press conference

shots.line: a name, a face,
shots.what: real: his photo as it went out on the news

shots.line: and an address.
shots.what: road map: amber pin on Canadensis (the town only, no house)

shots.line: What they didn't have was Eric Frein.
shots.what: real photo: empty Pocono woods, held, slowest push (music out here)

shots.line: Eric Frein was thirty-one and lived with his parents
shots.what: his FBI photo, name types on, with the chapter line CHAPTER 03 / WHO THEY WERE LOOKING FOR

card.name: ERIC FREIN
card.sub: CHAPTER 03  ·  WHO THEY WERE LOOKING FOR

shots.line: in Canadensis, a small town in Barrett Township
shots.what: road map: Canadensis pinned, BARRETT TOWNSHIP types on

shots.line: in the same part of the Poconos.
shots.what: real photo: the main road through Canadensis

shots.line: He belonged to a military reenactment group,
shots.what: police-released photo: Frein in re-enactor uniform with a rifle

shots.line: the kind of hobby where people put on uniforms and act out history.
shots.what: same photo, closer on the uniform and cap

shots.line: Frein's group portrayed Eastern European soldiers.
shots.what: the FBI wanted page, highlighter on its line about Serbian and Russian

shots.line: During the manhunt, Lieutenant Colonel George Bivens of the state police said Frein
shots.what: real: Bivens at the podium; name tag types on

shots.line: appeared to have assumed that role in real life.
shots.what: typed card with an amber bar (his description, not a word-for-word quote)

card.who: AS DESCRIBED BY LT. COL. GEORGE BIVENS

shots.line: Police also told reporters that Frein had talked about
shots.what: real: Commissioner Noonan at the podium; name tag types on

shots.line: wanting to commit mass murder.
shots.what: real: Noonan, punched in

shots.line: They weren't describing a man who'd snapped one night.
shots.what: real: the roadblock, with the police-released photo of him inset

shots.line: Police said Frein had been preparing for months, maybe years.
shots.what: real police photo: bags and gear at the campsite

shots.line: His computer showed research on avoiding police manhunts, on law enforcement technology, and on survival.
shots.what: 3D object: a laptop; the three topics type on the screen one at a time as they are said
shots.head: COMPUTER SEARCHES  ·  COURT RECORD

shots.line: In his recorded statement after the arrest, he said he'd used Google Earth
shots.what: typed card: RECORDED STATEMENT

shots.line: to look at state police barracks near his home
shots.what: road map pulling out: his home town and the barracks, both pinned

shots.line: and that he chose Blooming Grove because of the woods around it.
shots.what: 3D: the barracks from above, ringed by woods

shots.line: Hold on to that recorded statement, by the way.
shots.what: typed card: RECORDED STATEMENT, with HOLD ON TO THIS under it

shots.line: Years later, Pennsylvania's highest court would say the jury should never have seen it.
shots.what: the court opinion, page 28: highlighter on the ruling that the statements should have been suppressed
